meta_description: Top Reasons to Book this Lovely Home:* Spacious Home in Highland Parks* Bicycles (4) Included for Access to the Beach* Blue Mountain Beach Access- 1.3 miles (Parking, Restrooms and Seasonal Lifeguards)* Pool w/Waterfall (Seasonally heated starting in March), Hot Tub,
description_expanded: Top Reasons to Book this Lovely Home:* Spacious Home in Highland Parks* Bicycles (4) Included for Access to the Beach* Blue Mountain Beach Access- 1.3 miles (Parking, Restrooms and Seasonal Lifeguards)* Pool w/Waterfall (Seasonally heated starting in March), Hot Tub, Gazebo, Community Grilling Area, 360-Observation Tower* Close by Redfish Village and Gulf Place Town Center* Under 1 mile to Blue Mountain Beach Creamery* Snorkel the Sea Turtle Reef-more info under Area Attractions below* Professionally Managed; 24/7 Service *This property is not available to adults Under the age of 25. No Exceptions. * Introducing Barefoot Blessing, a stunning 4-bedroom, 3.5 bath house nestled in the heart of Highland Parks. This coastal paradise is the perfect escape for beach enthusiasts like you! Inside the home, you'll find a spacious kitchen adorned with sleek stainless-steel appliances and a cozy eat-in bar. Make memories to cherish on the private back patio that back up to Point Washington Forest, creating a tranquil oasis designed for relaxation and enjoyment. With its thoughtfully designed layout, Barefoot Blessing accommodates up to 12 guests comfortably. The master bedroom features a luxurious king bed, while two guest bedrooms each offer a queen bed. The fourth bedroom is perfect for the little ones, equipped with two twin-over-twin bunk beds. If you need extra space, the living room provides a sleeper sofa for your convenience. Get ready to immerse yourself in the ultimate vacation experience with incredible amenities that will make your stay unforgettable. Dive into the free-form tropically landscaped lagoon pool, complete with a relaxing whirlpool. For panoramic views like no other, ascend to the 360-degree observation tower and soak in the breathtaking vistas. The community offers a delightful grilling area and a cozy firepit with comfy chairs and couches, perfect for gathering with your loved ones. Savor the beach life as you sit back, chat, and sip on your favorite drinks in pure bliss. Embark on an exciting beach adventure by hopping on one of the four provided bikes and exploring the scenic bike trails leading to Seaside, Watercolor, and Grayton Beach. Let the salty breeze caress your face as you revel in the freedom of the open road. This elegant beach retreat promises an unforgettable vacation filled with blissful moments shared with family and friends. Escape the ordinary and infuse your life with a touch of Barefoot Blessing!*Parking is only available for 3 vehicles in the home's designated paved driveway. Street parking is not allowed. Violations are strictly enforced by the HOA. **We LOVE Snowbirds! Low Monthly Winter Rates* Snowbird Season runs January thru February, on a monthly basis. To prepare a qualified quote, select your arrival date (must be the 1st day of the month) and the departure date (must be the 1st day of the month). Alternate dates must be pre-approved. All monthly rentals are subject to an additional $150 cleaning fee. Please contact us with your interest and to further assist!"Highland Parks is the newest neighborhood in Blue Mountain Beach featuring a fantastic neighborhood pool with a waterfall, hot tub, gazebo, fire pit, snack bar, and observation tower. The area is the highest point in South Walton County and is surrounded by great eateries and local eclectic shops. Highland Parks is perfectly situated between Redfish Village and Gulf Place Town Center on Hwy 30A! Enjoy dining at local favorites The Perfect Pig, Red Door, Local Catch, or Basmati's. Check out the local art scene at Justin Gaffery’s art gallery.Bed Setup:First Floor: Master w/ King Bed and private bathroomLiving room: Queen Sleeper SofaSecond Floor: Guest Room: Queen Bed and private bathroomGuest Room: Queen Bed Guest Room: 2 Twin-over-Twin Bunk BedsAREA ATTRACTIONS: Seaside is a fantastic destination, most widely known for being featured in the Truman Show with Jim Carrey. Its incredible architecture has helped to make it famous but also its faithful replication of the kind of seaside town that used to be common up and down the coast. Seaside has its own Farmer's Market, post office, Repertory Theater, and neighborhood school. It boasts unique shopping, fantastic cuisine, and incredible architecture that makes Seaside famous. There are activities for everyone; kayak rentals, bike rentals, paragliding, fishing, golfing, hiking, swimming, tennis -- you'll find it all right here.Bike over to Blue Mountain Beach Creamery for some homemade scoops that will have your taste buds coming back! You'll have an array of dining options to choose from! The snorkelers in your group will love the new artificial reef called Sea Turtle Reef, deployed in 2017. Located just 783 feet out from the Grayton Beach State Park access, it is becoming a haven for sea life. Each of the 4 snorkeling reefs comprises 40 acres of permitted sea bottom. The Sea Turtle Reef is at a depth of 12-19 feet. We strongly recommend that snorkelers use a kayak, paddleboard, or other flotation device when visiting the snorkel reefs. Sea conditions can and do change quickly and often. Enjoy! Read less
